children: RNS Number : 6438V  Pineapple Power Corporation PLC  21 September 2026
CLN Conversion and Allotment of New Shares
Pineapple Power Corporation PLC (the "Company") announces the allotment of 11,600,000 new ordinary £0.001 shares to Nicholas Nelson, a director of the Company.
On 29th June 2026, the Company announced that it had raised £300,000 through the issue of Convertible Loan Notes ("CLNs") with a conversion price of £0.0025.

Mr Nelson participated in the CLNs in the amount of £20,000. He was also issued Convertible Loan Notes on the same terms against a £9,000 bridging loan he had provided to the Company at an earlier date.
Mr Nelson's total shareholding in the Company is now 11,600,000 shares.
Following this allotment the Company has 94,932,877 ordinary £0.001 shares in issue and £289,000 in CLNs, convertible into 115,600,000 Convertible Loan Notes
